# FlowControlRegistry { #timetoalign.timelines.FlowControlRegistry }

```python
timelines.FlowControlRegistry(elements=(), *, unit=None, number_type=None)
```

The flow control of one timeline: its elements in canonical order.

One collection holds every :class:`FlowControlElement`, ordered by
coordinate and then by ID; ``jumps``, ``jump_targets``, ``breaks``,
``section_breaks`` and ``barlines`` are views of it by class. All of
them are tuples: the collection changes through :meth:`add`,
:meth:`add_all`, :meth:`with_belief` and :meth:`with_beliefs` alone,
and no element ever leaves it. Every element carries an ID unique
within the registry and, once the registry belongs to a timeline,
within that timeline's whole manifest: an element whose minted ID is
taken is stored under a freshly minted ID, and one whose given ID is
taken is refused. A manifest writes the registry as the timeline's
``flow_control`` array.

The registry refuses what cannot be played: a second Jump at a
coordinate, a ``to`` naming neither a :class:`JumpTarget` of the
registry nor a place of its timeline, an ``after`` that does not name
exactly one destination of another Jump of the registry, and an element
or a destination's place lying outside the axis, which runs from 0 to
the timeline's length (from 0 on while that length is unknown, and for
a registry that belongs to no timeline).

An element that some actor believes ``"false"`` is rejected
(:attr:`FlowControlElement.is_rejected`, :meth:`with_belief`): it stays
in the registry and is written, but it is out of every rule, as what is
checked and as what is named. A rejected Jump and its replacement may
therefore share a coordinate. An element that another element not
rejected names (by ``to`` or ``after``) is not rejected alone: the
elements naming it are rejected in the same step
(:meth:`with_beliefs`).

| Name        | Type                                                                                                                   | Description                                            | Default   |
|-------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------|-----------|
| elements    | [Iterable](`collections.abc.Iterable`)\[[FlowControlElement](`timetoalign.timelines.flowcontrol.FlowControlElement`)\] | The elements the registry starts with, added together. | `()`      |
| unit        | [TimeUnit](`timetoalign.core.TimeUnit`) \| [str](`str`) \| None                                                        | The unit of the axis the registry is bound to, if any. | `None`    |
| number_type | [NumberType](`timetoalign.core.NumberType`) \| [str](`str`) \| None                                                    | The number type of that axis, if any.                  | `None`    |

## Attributes {.doc-section .doc-section-attributes}

| Name        | Type                                                | Description                                            |
|-------------|-----------------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------|
| unit        | [TimeUnit](`timetoalign.core.TimeUnit`) \| None     | The unit of the axis the registry is bound to, if any. |
| number_type | [NumberType](`timetoalign.core.NumberType`) \| None | The number type of that axis, if any.                  |

## Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}

```python
>>> from timetoalign.core import Coordinate, TimeUnit
>>> registry = FlowControlRegistry(unit=TimeUnit.quarters)
>>> registry.add(JumpTarget(Coordinate(16, "quarters"), id="segno"))
JumpTarget('segno' @ 16 quarters)
>>> registry.add(
...     Jump(
...         Coordinate(64, "quarters"),
...         [JumpDestination(to="segno", repeat_count=1, reset=False)],
...     )
... ).id
'jump_1'
>>> [element.role for element in registry.elements]
['jump_target', 'jump']
>>> registry.place_of(registry.jumps[0].targets[0], registry.jumps[0])
Coordinate(Fraction(16, 1), quarters)
```

### active_elements { #timetoalign.timelines.FlowControlRegistry.active_elements }

```python
timelines.FlowControlRegistry.active_elements(
    believer=None,
    beliefs=DEFAULT_BELIEFS,
    context=None,
)
```

Return the elements that are read as flow control, in canonical order.

Without a believer these are the elements not rejected: every
element but those some actor believes ``"false"``
(:attr:`FlowControlElement.is_rejected`). A believer narrows the
reading to that actor's beliefs: the belief filter of
:func:`~timetoalign.core.provenance.belief_mask`, read on each
element's provenance, where an element without provenance, or
without a belief of the believer's, is one the believer has not
decided on, and one the believer holds two beliefs in (in two
entries) is read as the more critical of them.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name     | Type                                                                                   | Description                                                                      | Default           |
|----------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-------------------|
| believer | [str](`str`) \| None                                                                   | The actor whose beliefs alone decide; None leaves out what any actor rejects.    | `None`            |
| beliefs  | [Collection](`collections.abc.Collection`)\[[BeliefState](`timetoshare.BeliefState`)\] | With a believer, the belief states kept; every state but ``"false"`` by default. | `DEFAULT_BELIEFS` |
| context  | [Mapping](`collections.abc.Mapping`)\[[str](`str`), [Any](`typing.Any`)\] \| None      | The JSON-LD context under which actors compare as IRIs.                          | `None`            |

#### Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type                       | Description                                     |
|--------|----------------------------|-------------------------------------------------|
|        | [ValueError](`ValueError`) | If *beliefs* is no collection of belief states. |

#### Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}

```python
>>> from timetoalign.core import Coordinate
>>> registry = FlowControlRegistry(unit="quarters")
>>> barline = registry.add(Barline(Coordinate(8, "quarters")))
>>> _ = registry.with_belief(barline.id, "ana", "false", date="2026-11-25")
>>> registry.elements, registry.active_elements()
((Barline('barline_1' @ 8 quarters),), [])
>>> registry.active_elements(believer="bea")
[Barline('barline_1' @ 8 quarters)]
```

### add { #timetoalign.timelines.FlowControlRegistry.add }

```python
timelines.FlowControlRegistry.add(element)
```

Add one element.

An element another one names (a :class:`JumpTarget` named by a
``to``, a :class:`Jump` named by an ``after``) is added before the
one naming it; :meth:`add_all` adds elements naming one another
together.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name    | Type                                                                         | Description   | Default    |
|---------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------|---------------|------------|
| element | [FlowControlElement](`timetoalign.timelines.flowcontrol.FlowControlElement`) | The element.  | _required_ |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                                                                         | Description                                                    |
|--------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [FlowControlElement](`timetoalign.timelines.flowcontrol.FlowControlElement`) | The stored element, with its coordinate on the registry's axis |
|        | [FlowControlElement](`timetoalign.timelines.flowcontrol.FlowControlElement`) | and its ID as admitted.                                        |

#### Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type                       | Description         |
|--------|----------------------------|---------------------|
|        | [ValueError](`ValueError`) | As :meth:`add_all`. |

### add_all { #timetoalign.timelines.FlowControlRegistry.add_all }

```python
timelines.FlowControlRegistry.add_all(elements)
```

Add several elements together, or none of them.

The elements may name one another in any order. An element whose
minted ID is taken is stored under a freshly minted ID, and the
elements added with it name it by that ID.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name     | Type                                                                                                                   | Description   | Default    |
|----------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|---------------|------------|
| elements | [Iterable](`collections.abc.Iterable`)\[[FlowControlElement](`timetoalign.timelines.flowcontrol.FlowControlElement`)\] | The elements. | _required_ |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                                                                                           | Description                                               |
|--------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [list](`list`)\[[FlowControlElement](`timetoalign.timelines.flowcontrol.FlowControlElement`)\] | The stored elements in the order given, each with its     |
|        | [list](`list`)\[[FlowControlElement](`timetoalign.timelines.flowcontrol.FlowControlElement`)\] | coordinate on the registry's axis and its ID as admitted. |

#### Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type                       | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
|--------|----------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [ValueError](`ValueError`) | If an element's given ID is already taken, its unit is not the registry's, or an element that is not rejected cannot be played among those not rejected: a coordinate holds a second Jump, a ``to`` names neither a JumpTarget of the registry nor a place of its timeline, an ``after`` does not name exactly one destination of another Jump of the registry, or the element's coordinate or the place of one of its destinations lies before 0 or beyond the known length of the registry's timeline. Nothing has changed then. |

### from_dict { #timetoalign.timelines.FlowControlRegistry.from_dict }

```python
timelines.FlowControlRegistry.from_dict(
    data,
    *,
    unit,
    number_type=None,
    places=None,
)
```

Restore a registry bound to a timeline's axis from its ``flow_control``.

Each element of the array states its ``role`` (``jump``,
``jump_target``, ``break``, ``section_break`` or ``barline``), its
coordinate a bare value on the axis that *unit* and *number_type*
(the unit's own when None) describe. The elements are added
together, in any order the array lists them. Keys the library does
not know are kept on each element and written back.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name        | Type                                                                                                      | Description                                                                                                                                                 | Default    |
|-------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| data        | [list](`list`)\[[dict](`dict`)\[[str](`str`), [Any](`typing.Any`)\]\]                                     | The ``flow_control`` array.                                                                                                                                 | _required_ |
| unit        | [TimeUnit](`timetoalign.core.TimeUnit`) \| [str](`str`)                                                   | The axis's unit.                                                                                                                                            | _required_ |
| number_type | [NumberType](`timetoalign.core.NumberType`) \| [str](`str`) \| None                                       | The axis's number type, or None for the unit's own.                                                                                                         | `None`     |
| places      | [Mapping](`collections.abc.Mapping`)\[[str](`str`), [Coordinate](`timetoalign.core.Coordinate`)\] \| None | The places of the timeline a destination may name beside the array's jump targets: the starts of its Regions and of its child timelines and its own, by ID. | `None`     |

#### Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type                       | Description                                                                                                                                    |
|--------|----------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [ValueError](`ValueError`) | If the array or an element is malformed, an element is written in the form with ``type`` and ``target``, or the registry refuses the elements. |

### jump_at { #timetoalign.timelines.FlowControlRegistry.jump_at }

```python
timelines.FlowControlRegistry.jump_at(coordinate)
```

Return the Jump at *coordinate*, if one lies there.

Where a rejected Jump and its replacement lie together, the one not
rejected is returned; a rejected one where no other lies.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name       | Type                                                                                                                                                     | Description                                                                                                                                                                                    | Default    |
|------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| coordinate | [_Number](`timetoalign.timelines.flowcontrol._Number`) \| [Coordinate](`timetoalign.core.Coordinate`) \| [IdCoordinate](`timetoalign.core.IdCoordinate`) | A position on the registry's axis: a bare value, a :class:`~timetoalign.core.Coordinate` or an :class:`~timetoalign.core.IdCoordinate` in the registry's unit, read in the axis's number type. | _required_ |

#### Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type                       | Description                                          |
|--------|----------------------------|------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [ValueError](`ValueError`) | If a coordinate object's unit is not the registry's. |

### place_of { #timetoalign.timelines.FlowControlRegistry.place_of }

```python
timelines.FlowControlRegistry.place_of(destination, jump, *, elements=None)
```

Return where *destination* of *jump* goes on.

``by`` is added to the Jump's coordinate. ``to`` is the coordinate
of the JumpTarget of that ID, else the place of that ID the
registry's timeline gives (the start of a Region or of a child
timeline, or the timeline's own start). A destination without place
goes on at the nearest section break before the Jump, or at 0.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name        | Type                                                                                                                           | Description                                                                                                                | Default    |
|-------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| destination | [JumpDestination](`timetoalign.timelines.flowcontrol.JumpDestination`)                                                         | The destination.                                                                                                           | _required_ |
| jump        | [Jump](`timetoalign.timelines.flowcontrol.Jump`)                                                                               | The Jump holding it.                                                                                                       | _required_ |
| elements    | [Sequence](`collections.abc.Sequence`)\[[FlowControlElement](`timetoalign.timelines.flowcontrol.FlowControlElement`)\] \| None | The elements to find jump targets and section breaks among; the elements not rejected (:meth:`active_elements`) when None. | `None`     |

#### Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type                   | Description                                         |
|--------|------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------|
|        | [KeyError](`KeyError`) | If ``to`` names nothing, or a rejected jump target. |

### to_dict { #timetoalign.timelines.FlowControlRegistry.to_dict }

```python
timelines.FlowControlRegistry.to_dict(minimal=True)
```

Return the elements as the ``flow_control`` array.

Each element is written as its own object, in canonical order
whatever order the elements were added in: by coordinate, then by
ID, values compared exactly and IDs by Unicode code point. Nothing
is written that the registry does not hold.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name    | Type           | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     | Default   |
|---------|----------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------|
| minimal | [bool](`bool`) | Write each element in the minimal form (the default): every key at its default value left out, in the destinations of a Jump too. With False, the complete form: ``name``, ``label`` and ``meta`` of every element and ``determined``, ``reset`` and ``label`` of every destination are written whatever they hold. A key without a default (``manifestation``, ``ends``, ``provenance``, ``to``, ``by``, ``passes``, ``repeat_count``, ``after``) is written only when stated. | `True`    |

### with_belief { #timetoalign.timelines.FlowControlRegistry.with_belief }

```python
timelines.FlowControlRegistry.with_belief(
    element_id,
    actor,
    belief,
    *,
    date=None,
    note=None,
    context=None,
)
```

Record *actor*'s belief in the element *element_id*.

The registry holds the element's copy whose provenance records the
belief (:meth:`FlowControlElement.with_belief`) in its place; the
element's ID, coordinate and every other key stay. The belief
``"false"`` rejects the element, which is how flow control is
repaired: the wrong element is rejected and another one added,
never changed or removed.

What names a rejected element would name nothing. An element that
another element not rejected names, by a ``to`` or an ``after``, is
therefore not rejected alone: :meth:`with_beliefs` rejects it
together with the elements naming it, and their replacements are
added afterwards.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name       | Type                                                                              | Description                                                                      | Default    |
|------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| element_id | [str](`str`)                                                                      | The element's ID.                                                                | _required_ |
| actor      | [str](`str`)                                                                      | Who holds the belief, an IRI.                                                    | _required_ |
| belief     | [BeliefValue](`timetoalign.core.provenance.BeliefValue`)                          | ``"true"``, ``"false"`` or ``"unlikely"``.                                       | _required_ |
| date       | [str](`str`) \| [datetime](`datetime`).[date](`datetime.date`) \| None            | The day, ``YYYY-MM-DD`` or a :class:`datetime.date`; today when None.            | `None`     |
| note       | [str](`str`) \| None                                                              | A remark.                                                                        | `None`     |
| context    | [Mapping](`collections.abc.Mapping`)\[[str](`str`), [Any](`typing.Any`)\] \| None | The JSON-LD context under which actors compare as IRIs; None declares no prefix. | `None`     |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                                                                         | Description                               |
|--------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-------------------------------------------|
|        | [FlowControlElement](`timetoalign.timelines.flowcontrol.FlowControlElement`) | The element as the registry holds it now. |

#### Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type                       | Description                                        |
|--------|----------------------------|----------------------------------------------------|
|        | [KeyError](`KeyError`)     | If the registry holds no element *element_id*.     |
|        | [ValueError](`ValueError`) | As :meth:`with_beliefs`. Nothing has changed then. |

#### Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}

```python
>>> from timetoalign.core import Coordinate
>>> registry = FlowControlRegistry(unit="quarters")
>>> wrong = registry.add(
...     Jump(Coordinate(16, "quarters"), [JumpDestination(repeat_count=1)]))
>>> registry.with_belief(wrong.id, "ana", "false").is_rejected
True
>>> registry.add(
...     Jump(Coordinate(16, "quarters"), [JumpDestination(by=-8, repeat_count=1)])
... ).id
'jump_2'
>>> registry.jump_at(16).id
'jump_2'
```

### with_beliefs { #timetoalign.timelines.FlowControlRegistry.with_beliefs }

```python
timelines.FlowControlRegistry.with_beliefs(
    element_ids,
    actor,
    belief,
    *,
    date=None,
    note=None,
    context=None,
)
```

Record *actor*'s belief in several elements in one step, or in none.

As :meth:`with_belief` for each element, the result checked as a
whole: with the belief ``"false"``, an element and the elements
naming it are rejected together, which neither could be alone.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name        | Type                                                                              | Description                                                                      | Default    |
|-------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| element_ids | [Iterable](`collections.abc.Iterable`)\[[str](`str`)\]                            | The elements' IDs.                                                               | _required_ |
| actor       | [str](`str`)                                                                      | Who holds the belief, an IRI.                                                    | _required_ |
| belief      | [BeliefValue](`timetoalign.core.provenance.BeliefValue`)                          | ``"true"``, ``"false"`` or ``"unlikely"``.                                       | _required_ |
| date        | [str](`str`) \| [datetime](`datetime`).[date](`datetime.date`) \| None            | The day, ``YYYY-MM-DD`` or a :class:`datetime.date`; today when None.            | `None`     |
| note        | [str](`str`) \| None                                                              | A remark.                                                                        | `None`     |
| context     | [Mapping](`collections.abc.Mapping`)\[[str](`str`), [Any](`typing.Any`)\] \| None | The JSON-LD context under which actors compare as IRIs; None declares no prefix. | `None`     |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                                                                                           | Description                                                      |
|--------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [list](`list`)\[[FlowControlElement](`timetoalign.timelines.flowcontrol.FlowControlElement`)\] | The elements as the registry holds them now, in the order given. |

#### Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type                       | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
|--------|----------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [KeyError](`KeyError`)     | If the registry holds no element of one of the IDs.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
|        | [ValueError](`ValueError`) | If the belief or the date is invalid; an element rejected by the step is named, by a ``to`` or an ``after``, by an element that is not rejected after it; or an element no longer rejected by the step cannot be played among the elements not rejected (:meth:`add_all`). Nothing has changed then. |

#### Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}

```python
>>> from timetoalign.core import Coordinate
>>> registry = FlowControlRegistry(unit="quarters")
>>> segno, leap = registry.add_all([
...     JumpTarget(Coordinate(4, "quarters"), id="segno"),
...     Jump(Coordinate(16, "quarters"), [JumpDestination(to="segno")], id="ds"),
... ])
>>> registry.with_belief("segno", "ana", "false")
Traceback (most recent call last):
...
ValueError: jump_target 'segno' is not rejected alone: jump 'ds' names it. Reject the elements naming it in the same step (with_beliefs), then add their replacements
>>> [e.is_rejected for e in registry.with_beliefs(["segno", "ds"], "ana", "false")]
[True, True]
```
